posting.title: Copywriter/ Content Writer (Remote)
posting.description: <p dir="ltr"><strong>Job role:</strong></p><p dir="ltr">We're looking for a skilled content writer to work with teams across the company and craft valuable content that will educate our customers and wow our prospects. Your work will have you fiddling with taglines on website pages, writing blog posts for feature announcements, putting together thought leadership posts for guest publications, sketching educational collateral, framing scripts for feature videos, building presentations to better explain features, birthday cards and so on. Your projects will be your own to run, with complete creative freedom, but your content will need to align with brand guidelines.</p><p dir="ltr"><br></p><p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p><ul><li dir="ltr">Develop, write and deliver persuasive copy for the website, email marketing campaigns, sales collateral, videos and blogs</li><li dir="ltr">Build and run an editorial calendar; coordinate with other content crafters to ensure standards</li><li dir="ltr">Optimize all content for SEO to better reach</li><li dir="ltr">Measure impact and perform analysis to improve critical metrics.</li><li dir="ltr">Help with localization of process and content to ensure consistency across regions</li><li dir="ltr">Review and implement process changes to drive operational excellence</li></ul><p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p><ul><li dir="ltr">[2] years of working as a content marketer or in a similar position</li><li dir="ltr">Bachelor's degree in English, communications, linguistics, or related field (Master's degree, a plus)</li><li dir="ltr">Tech-savvy with the ability to explain complex technical matters in a simple manner without using jargon</li><li dir="ltr">Excellent attention to detail and ability to multi-task projects and deliverables</li><li dir="ltr">Confirmed experience working with deadlines to deliver high quality output in a short span of time</li></ul><p><br></p><p dir="ltr">We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</p>

posting.title: Customer Support Representative (Remote) online
posting.description: <div><strong>About the job<br></strong>Customer Support Representatives will primarily report to a Sr. Qualitative Specialist, who leads handling customer requests and associated procedures. We have a collaborative and innovative workplace and the expectation is that as a Customer Support Representative, you will work closely with other departments to improve tactics, processes, and communications over time.<br><br>A Representative may need to respond to chat requests and be present in interviews after typical work hours or on the weekend. Weekday schedules will be flexible in order to balance out these commitments as necessary.<br><br>Responsibilities<br>Help members troubleshoot issues they encounter while using the Live platform and provide actionable tips to resolve the problem.<br>Represent the client in IDI &amp; Focus Group Waiting rooms &amp; proactively confirm member qualification and device functionality prior to interviews.<br>Follow communication and security procedures, guidelines, and policies including all known PI procedures.<br>Moderate incoming Qualitative Research Responses based on Commercial team requests and general platform quality support needs.<br><br>Qualifications<br>Previous customer service experience.<br>Strong verbal and written communication skills<br>Experience multi-tasking in a fast-paced and changing environment<br>Proactive, organized, and detail oriented<br>Self-starting professional with a positive attitude<br>Empathetic communicator with a customer-focused mindset<br>Problem-solving and logical thinking skills; you demonstrate initiative, take ownership of customers' needs, and make suggestions to improve processes and customer service<br>Ability to work in a team environment and work a flexible or weekend schedule to meet our business needs<br>Computer-literate and proficient in Microsoft Excel / Google Drive<br>Previous Salesforce and or Zendesk experience is a plus, but not required<br><br>Benefits<br>We take care of our employees and their families. We have generous health dental and vision benefits, and our 401K plan vests immediately<br>A friendly, fun, and collaborative work environment that allows for frequent exposure to executives<br>The opportunity to make an immediate impact as a part of a fast-growing company<br>The target base compensation for this role is $45,000 - $69,000 / yr.</div>
